name: temp-core-loop-stability
description: Small-signal .ac loop-gain testbench for temp_core's error amplifier loop (issue #274). Breaks the loop at PG -- the amplifier's own output stays on that node (probed via v(xdut.pg)); the two mirror-gate connections that actually close the loop (XMP1, XMP2) move to a new node PG_FB the testbench injects an AC test signal onto. Reports the closed-loop-equivalent open-loop gain T(jw) = V(xdut.pg)/V(pg_fb), its unity-gain crossover frequency, phase margin there, and gain margin at the frequency the loop phase crosses zero. See testbench/tb_temp_core_loop_stability.spice's header for the break-point construction and the algebra showing the measured ratio does not depend on the injection source's polarity or amplitude, and design/temp_core.md's 'Error amplifier' section for the topology this loop implements.
claim: design/temp_core.md#loop-stability -- not a spec/target-spec.md claim: issue #274's own scoping question ('does a phase-margin bound belong in spec/target-spec.md?') is resolved here as 'not yet' -- every sim/temp-core-*/ transient record already shows the loop settling cleanly at every PVT point with no ringing or non-convergence, so there is no evidence of an actual instability problem motivating a new ratified bound today. This record closes the coverage gap (a quantified phase/gain margin has never been measured for this loop at all) and gives design/temp_core.md something to cite instead of merely naming the gap; promoting a specific number to spec/target-spec.md is left as a separate, deliberate decision (its own decision record) for whenever a concrete margin requirement is actually needed. Deterministic corners only (design.ngspice sets sw_stat_mismatch=0) -- mismatch on this loop's own devices is out of scope for a stability-margin measurement (mismatch perturbs the DC operating point and the input-referred offset, not the small-signal loop dynamics around it).
analyses: meas ac fc0db find frequency when loopgain_db=0 cross=1
meas ac phase_at_fc0db find loopphase_deg when loopgain_db=0 cross=1
meas ac fpx0 find frequency when loopphase_deg=0 cross=1
meas ac gain_at_fpx0 find loopgain_db when loopphase_deg=0 cross=1

dc_bias_delta_mv.description: the loop-break injection source (DC value 0) must reproduce the true closed-loop DC operating point exactly -- v(xdut.pg) and v(pg_fb) are the same physical node in design/netlist/temp_core.spice, so a 0 V DC source between them is indistinguishable from the wire it replaces. A nonzero delta here means the break technique is loading the circuit (see testbench/tb.json's description and sim/temp-core-designer-check's own vptat/vctat DC records for the closed-loop cross-check this substitutes for).

phase_margin_deg.description: sanity bound only, not a spec target -- see design/temp_core.md's 'Loop stability' note and issue #274's 'What to do': no phase-margin bound is ratified in spec/target-spec.md yet. This just catches a computation error (e.g. a missed unit conversion) producing a value outside what a phase in degrees can ever be.
